defs.meaning: 受喜爱的人（或事物）；（比赛或竞赛中）最有希望的获胜者；收藏夹（等于favourite）

examples.en: What's your favorite and less favorite Chinese food?
examples.zh: 你最喜欢和不太喜欢的中国菜是什么？

examples.en: What's your favorite food? My favorite food is salad.
examples.zh: 你最喜欢什么食物？我最喜欢的食物是沙拉。

synonyms.meaning: 幸运儿；喜欢的事物；特别喜欢的人
最喜爱的；中意的；宠爱的

individual.mnemonic: favor（好感）+ ite → 情有独钟的 → 最喜爱的

pastExamSents.en: I thought of a number of names right away: the owner of our local bookstore, who let me and my little son in before the store opened and offered to play his favorite songs; our babysitter, who dropped off a bag of old board games for our kids to play; … While writing the notes, I realized how often I had spent my time on the phone moving from app to app, appreciating (欣赏) other people's lives.
pastExamSents.zh: 我马上想到了许多名字：我们当地书店的老板，他在开店前让我和我的小儿子进去，并主动播放他最喜欢的歌曲；我们的保姆，她会放下一袋旧的棋盘游戏给我们的孩子玩；……在写这些笔记时，我意识到我有多少次花时间在手机上，从一个软件到另一个软件，欣赏着别人的生活。

pastExamSents.en: My favorite part of the day was meeting the school cook and improving the school menus for the week.
pastExamSents.zh: 一天中我最喜欢的部分是和学校厨师见面，改进学校一周的菜单。

pastExamSents.en: I write songs about everything: about getting dressed, about flowers, about my favorite food—you name it!
pastExamSents.zh: 我写关于一切的歌：关于穿衣服，关于花，关于我最喜欢的食物——凡是你说得出的！
pastExamSents.source: 2021·贵州-安顺，贵州-贵阳，贵州-六盘水·阅读

pastExamSents.en: The favorite food in our class is snacks.
pastExamSents.zh: 我们班上最受喜欢的食物是零食。

pastExamSents.en: On Halloween, he had his parents carve a pangolin into their pumpkin, so that when people asked what it was, he could tell them all about his favorite animal.
pastExamSents.zh: 在万圣节前夕，他让父母在南瓜上雕刻一只穿山甲，这样当人们问起这是什么时，他就能告诉他们关于他最喜欢的动物的一切了。

idiomatic.zh: 最喜爱的食物 / 运动 / 科目 / 演员
